verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs claim whole-project refactoring and multi-file refactoring over a million-token context (kimi-docs-6, kimi-docs-8). A help-center entry also lists an 'Agent cluster' (Agent集群) mode (kimi-docs-15). Together these suggest the agent can act across many files or tasks at once, but nothing documents a general bulk-operation feature. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability across arbitrary items, documentation of how Agent cluster parallelizes work, and hands-on corroboration of bulk edits succeeding at scale.
